datasets.purpose: IPC Classification spatial data in different IPC scenarios collected by FEWS NET enumerators on a regular schedule (typically monthly).

lineage.description: FEWS NET enumerators conducted regular (typically monthly) field assessments across DRC administrative units to classify acute food insecurity using the IPC framework. Geographic boundaries and IPC phase classifications were compiled into spatial datasets (GeoJSON/KML) for January through April 2022, representing the current situation analysis of food insecurity conditions.
